<div class="review-text">
Precisely what it says on the tin. I've played a variety of slight chess variants in my life, and read about more; 5D chess is just another entry in the long line of remixes from strange packaged one's like Steve Jackson's Tile Chess to the plethora of minor variants on <a href="http://chess.com">chess.com</a>. If you like those, you might like this, and vice versa. At the end of the day though, it's just chess, so if you don't like chess at a fundamental level this won't change what it is.
